messages:
hana: ok team — final reminder: office March Madness pool picks due by 11:59pm tonight. prizes: winner gets catered bagels + bragging rights sticker. :basketball:

sam: putting my faith in the 12-seed upset pick. may the chaos begin. :crossed_fingers:

omar: classic sam move. also FYI i made a tiny tiebreaker rule — closest total points in the final wins. no sudden-death coin flips.

lucy: whoops i keep procrastinating. is there a guide to filling the bracket? i always freeze on the 2nd round.

hana: quick tips: seed history (12-5 upsets are a thing), look at injuries, trust teams with defense. also our pool allows 1 upset bonus (x2 points) so use it wisely.

dave: submitted mine. went bold with a 11-seed to the Sweet 16. also i demand a parade if that happens.

bracket-bot: bracket link created: https://sheets.example.com/office-brackets-2026 (edit access: hana, sam, omar, lucy, dave)

sam: lucy — i'll jump on a 5-minute screenshare to walk through if you want.

lucy: yes please @sam, saved.

hana: poll: who picked upset bonus on a seed >=10?
```
1) me (hana) — 11-seed to R16
2) sam — 12-seed to R16
3) omar — 10-seed to R8
4) dave — none, played it safe
```

omar: voted 3. riding the chaos train.

sam: voted 2. also reminder: fantasy hoops trade deadline tomorrow 3pm so if anyone is flipping players, ping the commish.

lucy: trade question: can you drop injured players? my league auto-scrubs IR after 2 weeks but i vaguely recall rule 7b.

hana: yes IR swap allowed until deadline. commish (looking at you @dave) has final say on weird edgecases.

dave: noted. i will be the benevolent commish unless bribed with bagels.

bracket-bot: automated reminder set for 23:45 tonight — last call for brackets.

sam: hypothetical: if two people tie for first, do we split the bagel order or does the runner-up lose dignity and fetch coffee for a week?

omar: split the bagels, but loser has to wear sticker for a week. more content that way. :stuck_out_tongue: 

lucy: can we have a bracket-bingo side game? first to 5 answers (upset, buzzer-beater, OT, coach ejected, double OT) wins candy jar.

hana: love the bingo idea. omar, you're on candy-jar procurement duty if we win.

omar: bruh fine. cheap candy or premium?

sam: premium. nothing says morale like gourmet gummy bears.

hana: final logistics: bring your own devices if you want to live update. meeting room B reserved 7pm for watch party of the first round — or join virtually via the bracket sheet.

dave: oh and heads up — i may be late because of dentist appointment. do not start without me, unless it's a 12-seed miracle.

lucy: dentist or clutch upset? both plausible.

bracket-bot: reminder posted in #random at 23:45 and email sent to participants.

sam: good luck everyone — and may the most chaotic bracket win. :trophy:
